messages.author: 8fc2bc9cca049463
messages.subject: Parser error? Not recognizing distribution?
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to understand why I'm getting this error. Why isn't it recognizing the distribution name?

Error in stanc(file = file, model_code = model_code, model_name = model_name,  :
  failed to parse Stan model 'nb_mod' with error message:
EXPECTATION FAILURE LOCATION: file=input; line=29, column=7

      taxon_ct[i,j] ~ negative_binomial(theta[j],theta[j]/exp(log_alpha[j] - pow((beta[j] - logcond[i])/gam[j],2)));
      ^-- here


DIAGNOSTIC(S) FROM PARSER:
no matches for function name="negative_binomial_log"
    arg 0 type=int
    arg 1 type=real
    arg 2 type=real
available function signatures for negative_binomial_log:
unknown distribution=negative_binomial
Parser expecting: "}"

Here is my model specification:
nb_mod <- '
data {
  int<lower=0> I; //number of sites
  int<lower=0> J; //number of taxa
  vector[I] logcond; //log(conductivity) value at each site
  int<lower=0> taxon_ct[I,J]; //count of taxon at each site
}
parameters {
  vector<lower=0>[J] theta;
  real<lower=0> h;
  vector[J] log_alpha;
  vector[J] beta;
  vector<lower=0>[J] prec;
  real mu_logalpha;
  real<lower=0> tau_logalpha;
  real mu_beta;
  real<lower=0> tau_beta;
  real<lower=0> rho;
}
transformed parameters {
  vector<lower=0>[J] gam;
  for (j in 1:J){
    gam[j] <- pow(prec[j],-0.5);
  }
}
model {
  for (j in 1:J){
    for (i in 1:I){
      taxon_ct[i,j] ~ negative_binomial(theta[j],theta[j]/exp(log_alpha[j] - pow((beta[j] - logcond[i])/gam[j],2)));
    }
  }
  mu_logalpha ~ normal(0,sqrt(1000));
  tau_logalpha ~ uniform(0,100);
  log_alpha ~ normal(mu_logalpha,tau_logalpha);
  mu_beta ~ normal(0,sqrt(1000));
  tau_beta ~ uniform(0,100);
  beta ~ normal(mu_beta,tau_beta);
  h ~ gamma(1,1);
  theta ~ gamma(1,h); 
  rho ~ gamma(1,1);
  prec ~ gamma(1, rho);
}
generated quantities {
  vector<lower=0>[J] alpha;
  vector[J] XC90;
  vector[J] XC75;
  vector[J] XC95;
  alpha <- exp(log_alpha);
  XC95 <- 1.644854*gam + beta;
  XC90 <- 1.281552*gam + beta;
  XC75 <- 0.6744898*gam + beta;
}

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Parser error? Not recognizing distribution?
parts:
On Monday, August 5, 2013 8:55:08 AM UTC-4, kris2...@gmail.com wrote:
I'm trying to understand why I'm getting this error. Why isn't it recognizing the distribution name?

The density in question is called neg_binomial() in Stan. In general, all function names in Stan are given in the index to the manual.

Ben

messages.author: 8fc2bc9cca049463
messages.subject: Re: Parser error? Not recognizing distribution?
parts: Thanks. My apologies, I was looking at an older version of the manual and didn't realize it.

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Parser error? Not recognizing distribution?
parts:
We were a bit inconsistent in naming. Usually we spell things out,
but we abbreviated "negative" to "neg" and "probability"
to "prob" throughout.

- Bob
